# Netra KBC (TarkShastra)

> Free Hindi quiz app in KBC style by Prayagi Store and Services. Question pool plus optional AI-generated questions.

## Pages
- [Home](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/KBC/): features and download.
- [Play in browser](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/KBC/play.html): web version.
- [Legal & data](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/legal/): privacy policy and data safety.
